thread:
taylor_ops: Quick sync — GlobalProc delivered a partial APAC allocation. 30 H100s landed at KIX-hub, 8 units failing initial burn. Vendor proposes split: 4 air to SIN-depot for immediate swap, 4 sea-return to vendor. They want 60% expedite fee share and want us to take insurance. Need routing + cost decision + customs. @rachel_procurement @dani_logistics

rachel_procurement: Please send serials, failure summary, and the full expedite quote breakdown (carrier, fuel, handling, insurance). We should cap our expedite share at 25% unless vendor covers duties/insurance. Which cost center should this hit — infra or procurement?

dani_logistics: SIN-depot can accept 4 air swaps same-day if brackets are included. Sea return ETA ~14d, vendor repair SLA ~10 business days after receipt. Carrier options for air: SQ or NH. We strongly recommend insurance; vendor says they only carry basic liability. We'll need commercial invoice + HS code before customs clearance.

omar_platform: Cluster impact note: APAC Dedicated pool = 120 H100s. Losing 8 degraded units is ~6.7% capacity and could affect peak gen jobs. Recommend routing some workloads to EU-dedicated spare pool and spinning up 3 hot-spare instances in APAC for 48h as buffer. Est cost ~ $2.1k/day. Also ask vendor to confirm failure domain: PSU vs NVLink vs thermal.

taylor_ops: Vendor failure summary: 8 units show "no POST" + thermal excursion flags. Serial list (redacted): H100-GP-201; H100-GP-202; H100-GP-203; H100-GP-204; H100-GP-205; H100-GP-206; H100-GP-207; H100-GP-208. Air quote = $42,500 total + customs + insurance. Vendor asks for 60% expedite split but will cover carrier surge portion. Prefers consolidated AWB to SIN-depot.

rachel_procurement: Counter-proposal: 30% expedite share if vendor covers customs and insurance and provides carrier invoice with surcharge breakdown. Require timestamped photos, signed DOA, and vendor COA (certificate of authenticity). We will not accept 60% without receipts.

dani_logistics: Depot manifest_v4 required. Example header for pre-alert CSV: AWB,Carrier,ShipFrom,ShipTo,ItemCount,Serials,HSCode,Insurance,DeclaredValue,RMA_type. No crossdock allowed; depot needs 24h pre-alert and manifest_v4 formatted CSV. If vendor refuses insurance, finance must approve self-insure.

finance_bot: FYI — self-insurance policy: PO-level approval required when declared value > $500,000. Expedite fee default cost center: infra-capex unless procurement requests otherwise. If vendor refuses to insure, escalate to finance for approval.

taylor_ops: Action items:
1) taylor_ops — upload failure logs + photos + full serial manifest by 11:00 JST.
2) rachel_procurement — draft PO amendment with 30% counter and request carrier invoice breakdown.
3) dani_logistics — pre-book SIN-depot slot conditional on AWB; estimate 24h bench swap.
4) omar_platform — enable routing to EU pool and reserve 3 hot-spares in APAC.
SLA target: 96h end-to-end for APAC swap path.

ops_bot: Reminder set — follow up with GlobalProc in 8h for AWB and DOA photos.

rachel_procurement: I'll loop in legal & finance and push the PO amendment. If vendor insists on 60% and refuses insurance, we will opt for sea-return depot repair. Tagging legal: @rachel_procurement/legal-review.

taylor_ops: Uploaded logs & photos to internal storage (placeholder): https://files.redwood.internal/rma/1789998888/ . Vendor replied they "can accept 30% if Redwood signs a transit NDA related to carrier rates" — legal review required. They also ask for AWB ASAP.

rachel_procurement: Draft sent to vendor pending legal. If vendor refuses to provide carrier receipts or insurance, escalate to finance. We will not pay >30% expedite w/o documentation.

End of thread.
